statement: For each d>=2, with the fixed uniform ellipticity bound kappa=1/(4d), site-iid directionally transient homogeneous environments have velocities v=2epsilon e1 for arbitrary 0<epsilon<=1/(4d), and E T_1=1/(2epsilon). No positive lower speed bound or finite upper one-level crossing mean depending only on d,kappa is possible.
assumptions: Site iid includes a deterministic homogeneous environment
proof_or_counterexample: Explicit transition probabilities, iid increment SLLN, Chernoff summability and Wald; INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY.md B1.
remaining_gap: Independent proof check pending. Does not refute C0041.

statement: The one-dimensional iid environment with P(p_i=3/4)=3/4 and P(p_i=1/4)=1/4 is UE with kappa=1/4, transient to the right, and has speed zero. Its one-level crossing expectation has the lower bound E T_1>=2L+1 for every positive integer L, hence is infinite.
assumptions: Unconditional expectation over iid site environment
proof_or_counterexample: Scale function transience; geometric excursion recursion; unconditional independence of distinct sites; Birkhoff on truncated dependent stationary ergodic crossing durations; INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY.md B2.
remaining_gap: Independent proof check pending. No C0041 counterexample.

statement: For every d>=2 the explicitly layered environment omega(x,+e1)=p_x1/2, omega(x,-e1)=(1-p_x1)/2, omega(x,+/-ej)=1/[4(d-1)] with the critical iid layer law from B2 is UE and stationary ergodic under the full translation group. It is directionally transient in e1 with X_n/n ->0 and raw mean local e1 drift 1/8. It fails site independence: indicators of a favorable layer at distinct same-layer sites have covariance 3/16.
assumptions: Shared random parameter within each complete hyperplane
proof_or_counterexample: Bernoulli axial time change of B2, transverse bounded martingale SLLN, and explicit same-layer joint probability; INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY.md B3.
remaining_gap: Independent proof check pending. Genuine site iid is deliberately absent; C0041 remains untouched.

statement: For the critical iid one-dimensional law P(p_i=3/4)=3/4 and P(p_i=1/4)=1/4, the quenched probability q of never hitting -1 has E[q^(-lambda)] finite exactly for 0<=lambda<1. The walk has infinite first crossing mean and zero speed. The same survival probability occurs in the B3 layer-iid lift, which deliberately fails site independence.
assumptions: Nearest-neighbor critical two-point iid environment in dimension one
Or the explicitly layer-iid, not site-iid d>=2 lift
proof_or_counterexample: Harmonic scale gives q^-1=1+sum future rho products. Subadditivity gives E q^-lambda<=1/(1-E rho^lambda) for 0<lambda<1; E rho^lambda<1 follows from (3^lambda-1)(3^lambda-3)<0. Tonelli yields infinity at lambda=1; monotonicity covers lambda>1. See INVERSE_MOMENT_BOUNDARY.md.
remaining_gap: Independent review pending. Does not refute the public manuscript's later super-polynomial crossing estimate or C0041.
